goal: One practical text/vision chat core with real photographs, Chinese OCR and an explicit speech-transcription input route; written replies only.

core.architecture: Dense; frozen pretrained visual/language weights; language q_proj and v_proj rank-8 LoRA only

asr.license_note: HF card says Apache-2.0; upstream OpenAI repository explicitly licenses code and weights MIT. Preserve both source statements rather than inventing a unified upstream license.
asr.training: Frozen pretrained ASR; not retrained in this project; ordinary human read Mandarin tested separately from chat

lora.scope: Teach task and output behavior using train only; do not attribute broad upstream capability to this small sample

sequence: Verify source licenses, deterministic LFS data bytes and frozen train/validation/test families
CPU prepare pinned model cache and verify dataset assets
Evaluate pretrained base on validation only
Train genuine assistant-only LoRA with time-limited checkpoints and private backups
Compare adapter and base on validation; record final selection before opening test; if needed revise with validation only
Evaluate fixed base and selected adapter on identical final test cases; preserve raw predictions, truncation, errors and failures
Independently inspect image grounding and paired typed/spoken chat; metrics are teaching examples, not a broad benchmark
Publish reviewed inference adapter and verified model pins; verify anonymous public bytes and actual student workflow

evaluation.scene: 12 final photos; 12 open scene descriptions and 24 short grounded questions. Finite phrase matches are proxies; independent review checks actions, relationships, negation, unsupported claims and variants. No claim that base pretraining did not include public sources.
evaluation.ocr: Separate synthetic Traditional Chinese transcription, text presence and multi-line or vertical reading order; report exact count and edit-distance numerator/reference denominator. Keep font/phrase-heldout limits explicit. External natural Chinese examples are separately sourced and not redistributed as MIT training data.
evaluation.speech: 12 final human read Mandarin recordings; show real ASR hypotheses, raw codepoint/whitespace-normalized CER, typed-reference and ASR-input responses with identical history. Never substitute the correct transcript into speech inference. Human read statements are not spontaneous dialogue or verified Taiwan-accent coverage.
evaluation.text: Self-written heldout chat and multi-turn regressions; semantic correctness and instruction adherence require independent review, not exact-string equality alone.
evaluation.acceptance: Inspect validation before any final test. Report demonstrated capabilities and failures separately. Do not claim arbitrary image, OCR, voice or reasoning reliability from this small set; a trained adapter may be rejected if it degrades validation.

review_sequence: Independent new readers assess every added or changed section as a mathematically capable high-school student without project context; author fixes and owners reread
A separate fresh group verifies formulas, code, numbers, provenance and authoritative original sources; author fixes and owners recheck
A third fresh group reads preceding and following sections for continuity; author fixes and owners reread
Separate readers estimate updated page reading times; execute notebooks, check site and publish
